subject: gk
question:
Which of the following is NOT included while estimating National Income?

1. Goods sold by street hawkers

2. Services of housewives

3. Production of vegetable in kitchen garden
solution:
The correct answer is __**All 1, 2 and 3.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Goods sold by street hawkers, services of housewives, and production of vegetables in kitchen gardens are not included while estimating National Income.
 
• National Income estimation primarily includes goods and services that are part of the formal economy and have market value.
 
• Services of housewives and goods produced for self-consumption (like vegetables from a kitchen garden) do not have a market transaction and thus are excluded.
 
• Street hawkers' sales might be informal and unrecorded, so they are generally not included in National Income estimations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• National Income is a measure of the total value of goods and services produced by a country over a specific period, usually a year.
 
• It includes the income earned by the residents of the country from both domestic and foreign sources.
 
• Estimating National Income accurately is crucial for economic planning and policy formulation.
 
• Various methods like the income method, expenditure method, and production method are used to estimate National Income.
 
• The exclusion of informal and non-market activities can sometimes lead to an underestimation of the actual economic activity in a country.
